messages:
aj: Heads-up — started seeing OOM traces on a dedicated node after the continuous-batcher v2 rollout this morning. high KV footprint + long contexts.

infra-bot: deploy v2/continuous-batcher rolled to 40% at 2026-03-18T09:12Z

mia: repro steps?

aj: repro attached: seq len ~ 2048, kv size ~ 160MB, concurrent q=6, batcher formed 3 big batches -> OOM. paste of log snippet:
```
RuntimeOOM: alloc failed 256MiB
KVCache.used=158MB, KVCache.capacity=192MB
batch_tokens=560, batch_size=3
```

sanjay: thinking: admission should include KV footprint estimate. currently we only gate on token_budget and queue_age.

lina: kernel selection matters too — larger attention kernel shaves compute but increases transient memory. on A100 we should fall back to `lowmem-attn` for >1024 context.

kevin: perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood/team/continuous-batcher/2201 show spike after v2. throughput steady but p99 latency and mem usage up.

mia: proposed quickfix: early KV-aware admission: if kv_est + batch_est > node_headroom => reduce token_budget per request or hold to next batch.

aj: example config snippet:
```json
{
  "admission": {
    "token_budget": 1024,
    "kv_headroom_bytes": 50000000,
    "kv_weight": 1.2
  }
}
```

sanjay: heuristic we tried locally: kv_est = sum(kv_size_per_request); allowed_tokens = max(128, token_budget - kv_est/avg_token_kv); prevents assembling big batches that blow headroom.

perf-bot: nightly profiler: mem delta per batch formation +42% after v2 compared to baseline; top contributor=KV cache copy path.

lina: long term: avoid copying KV during batch assembly; prefer shared read-only view with refcounts. short term: admission is faster.

kevin: can we A/B the admission change on 10% of hosts? roll-forward if stable.

aj: I'll prepare a small rollout PR with KV-aware admission + feature flag. will add telemetry for rejected_admissions and headroom breaches.

mia: :thumbsup: please add a dashboard panel for kv_est distribution and admission_rate.

infra-bot: ticket created infra#4521 — continuous-batcher: KV-aware admission probe

sanjay: assigning to aj and lina. let's sync in 30m if PR lands.
